name: Ramayana
desc: When Rakshasa emperor Ravana, invincible to all but man, conquers the three worlds, Lord Vishnu descends as noble prince Rama. Bound by his father's vow, Rama enters perilous exile with virtuous Sita and devoted Lakshmana. When Ravana abducts Sita, God in human form rises to fight the greatest war ever.

name: Godzilla Minus Zero
desc: Japan is still rebuilding in 1949, two years after Godzilla’s devastating attack. Just as the Shikishima family begins to find its footing, a new threat shatters the fragile peace and puts their future at risk.

name: O.M: Operation Mole
desc: In the forests of Tiruvannamalai, an undercover mission to rescue 20 arrested woodcutters draws an operative into the world of a powerful red-sandalwood syndicate and a dangerous clash with the law of criminals.

name: Dune: Part Three
desc: Twelve years after the events of the previous chapter, Paul Atreides rules as Emperor of the known universe but faces mounting rebellion from rival Houses and internal betrayal. Worshipped by the Fremen and feared by his enemies, he must confront the cost of power and the consequences of his choices. As alliances shift and a new generation emerges, Paul’s reign is tested in ways he never imagined.

name: Avengers: Doomsday
desc: The Marvel multiverse stands on the brink of collapse as iconic heroes from different universes are forced into an epic battle against Doctor Doom. Survival demands unlikely alliances in the MCU's biggest crossover yet.

name: Pyre
desc: Set in the breathtaking Himalayas, Pyre is a deeply moving love story of an elderly couple who have waited 28 years for their son to return. When a letter arrives, it rekindles hope and stirs emotions long buried. A haunting cinematic journey into love, longing and the enduring power of hope.

name: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
desc: Twenty-four years before Katniss Everdeen, a young Haymitch enters the 50th Hunger Games, facing twice the usual tributes as he is forced to survive the Capitol’s spectacle and fight back against a system built to control him.

name: Kaali Kheti
desc: Set against a rural backdrop, Kaali Kheti explores a world where family, legacy and buried truths collide. Through the lens of agriculture and horror, it unravels an unsettling tale of fear rooted in familiar yet disturbing ground.

name: Ebenezer
desc: As Christmas approaches, Ebenezer Scrooge embarks on an extraordinary journey of self-discovery, reflection and redemption in this fresh take on a timeless tale.

name: How to Rob a Bank
desc: When an ambitious robbery sets events in motion, a group of unlikely players find themselves navigating risk, deception, and consequences in a game where every move matters.

name: SKS Mayookha
desc: A wave of murders targeting single women grips the city, and Mayookha starts noticing strange changes right inside her own home. As fear closes in, she fights to survive an invisible predator.

name: ENE Repeat
desc: Reuniting the iconic gang from Ee Nagaraniki Emaindi, ENE Repeat marks the return of Tharun Bhascker's much-loved friendship saga. Expect familiar faces, fresh memories and another unforgettable ride.

name: Ghost Soldier
desc: A weapons systems engineer and former Green Beret protects his Wyoming neighbors against a ruthless corporation threatening their rural community.

name: Wildwood
desc: When her baby brother is abducted by a murder of crows, teenager Prue McKeel ventures into a secret, forbidden forest. Alongside a classmate, she gets drawn into a war threatening a hidden, magical world.

name: Aakasamlo Oka Tara
desc: Embarking on a perilous journey across deep forested terrains, a rugged wanderer named Deva faces severe wilderness elements to uncover a long-buried historic map, racing to protect his village from corporate greed.

name: Scene
desc: Inbaraj, a police officer is forced to reopen a case he left unfinished years ago. This time, he must solve it with a chaotic and troublesome team. As they struggle to work together and deal with the twists and turns of the case, the investigation takes them on a chaotic and unpredictable ride.

name: Brindavihari
desc: In the mystical world of Brindavanam, Madhava's heart belongs to Radha, until she walks away. When Meera steps into his life, he must unravel the truth about his world and discover what love truly means.

name: Shankarabharanna
desc: Bus driver Shankara's routine journey takes a bizarre turn when supernatural hauntings and powerful adversaries cross his path. Trapped in an isolated village, he must confront its eerie mysteries and uncover buried truths.

name: AOT
desc: Embarking on a perilous journey across deep forested terrains, a rugged wanderer named Deva faces severe wilderness elements to uncover a long-buried historic map, racing to protect his village from corporate greed.

name: Bouma
desc: A struggling singer returns to an isolated estate tied to a past she can barely remember. As police investigate a series of missing women, buried secrets surface and the line between her forgotten memories and a growing mystery begins to blur.

name: Ramayana: The Legend of Prince Rama (2025)
desc: Experience the legendary tale of Ramayana brought to life through stunning animation.

name: Mookuthi Amman 2
desc: Returning to protect a young prince after an ancient queen's sacrifice, Goddess Mookuthi Amman unleashes a grand divine avatar across timelines to defeat a ruthless, dark sorceress amassing a new evil power.

name: Bachelor Party D'eux
desc: Bachelor Party D’eux is a spiritual successor to the iconic Malayalam film Bachelor Party (2012). The film carries forward the same raw energy,  irreverent humour,  style and spirit that made its predecessor an evergreen favourite. This film brings in a fresh chapter of friendship,  chaos and unforgettable moments.

name: I Play Rocky
desc: An unknown actor with an unshakable dream refuses to sell his screenplay unless he stars in it himself. This movie chronicles Sylvester Stallone's extraordinary fight to bring Rocky to life.

name: Flag
desc: Gulkand Kumar, an aspiring actor struggling with language and acceptance, is transformed into a major film star under the guidance of a wealthy mentor. As fame grows and fan clubs evolve into political influence, his rise toward power begins to challenge those who once controlled his path.

name: Maitreyaa
desc: When new relationships reshape the effortless closeness of two lifelong best friends, buried emotions surface testing whether their cherished bond is pure friendship or a deeper, unspoken love waiting to bloom.

name: Gondhal (2025)
desc: Suman is trapped in a marriage she never wanted. During a night-long Gondhal ritual, she turns her former suitor’s obsession to her advantage, setting off a dangerous game of desire, deception and survival.

name: Bandhu
desc: Brothers may fight, disagree and drift apart, but their bond runs deeper than their differences. As life puts their relationship to the test, two brothers discover that each other's happiness matters more than their own.

name: Ruff and Tuff Kanya
desc: Overprotective father Shiv Pandit can't bear the thought of his daughter Chhavi getting married. He'll do anything to delay it, but when she chooses her own groom, all hell breaks loose in a hilarious twist.

name: Drishyam: The Conclusion
desc: The final chapter of the acclaimed thriller trilogy. Years after outsmarting the police, Vijay Salgaonkar’s past resurfaces when new evidence threatens to expose his secret. As the investigation reopens, he must outwit the system once again to save his family.

name: Sathyavan Savithiri
desc: A courtroom setting brings two opposing sides into direct conflict, with a legal battle that centers on justice, perspective, and the tensions within the case.

name: Doraemon the Movie: New Nobita and the Castle of the Undersea Devil
desc: Nobita and his friends discover a secret underwater castle filled with mysteries and hidden treasures. Using Doraemon’s futuristic gadgets, they set off on an exciting ocean adventure packed with humor, teamwork, and imagination in a stunning underwater world.

name: Jijai
desc: A fearless woman refuses to bow to injustice in a world that keeps testing her. Inspired by Rajmata Jijau’s courage and leadership, she stands her ground and fights back when society expects her to stay silent.

name: The Cat in the Hat
desc: Meet the Cat in the Hat you don't know! Voiced by Bill Hader, this animated adventure sees Dr. Seuss’s beloved mischief-maker take on his biggest mission yet for the I.I.I.I. (Institute for the Institution of Imagination and Inspiration, LLC) to help Gabby and Sebastian, two siblings adjusting to life in a new town.

name: Chikeezing
desc: For Chikya, the grand school where his mother works is a world of wonder beyond the village he knows. Despite his family's poverty, the curious, restless boy dreams of getting inside and finding a way to make it happen.

name: Sadhak Bamakhyapa
desc: In 18th-century Bengal, saint Bamakhyapa, a great devotee of Goddess Tara, defies orthodox temple practices and uses his divine powers to help the needy, his faith reshaping spirituality and reforming humanity till his last breath.

name: Mitrata
desc: Mitrata follows college friends Abhin, Deep Moksh, and Ved alongside Jiya as they navigate love, heartbreak, and growing up. Facing tough choices and major sacrifices, their bond is tested, proving true friendship is unbreakable.

name: Bohurupi: The Golden Daku
desc: Inspired by true events from 1990s rural Bengal, a resourceful fugitive repeatedly outwits the police by adopting new identities. As his legend grows, an intense game of pursuit unfolds between the elusive outlaw and the law.

name: The Eken: Kerala-e Kurukshetra
desc: When a top-secret mission goes dangerously wrong, the last person anyone would call gets kidnapped into the job.  Eken Babu is in Kerala, and nothing will ever be the same.  Where sharp detective work meets outrageous comedy,  welcome to the world of Eken Babu,  Bengal’s biggest franchise,  now bigger,  crazier, and headed to Kerala.

name: Nanhey Dil
desc: Raghu, a laundryman's son, gets a chance to study alongside children from wealthy families. Though fear and self-doubt follow him into the classroom, six unexpected friendships help him find his place.

name: Party Animals
desc: Childhood best friends Mann and Armaan reunite for a New Year’s Eve bash in Mumbai, but their big night spirals into a riot of romantic drama, bumbling cops, wannabe gangsters, party-bus chaos and a very drunk horse.

name: John Doe
desc: A determined police officer investigates a mystery on the Kerala–Tamil Nadu border, but as clues lead to his past and everyone doubts him, one question haunts him: Am I good enough?

name: Orange Marangalude Veedu: House of Orange Trees
desc: When long-held secrets stir within an atmospheric countryside home surrounded by orange groves, three generations confront past regrets, fragile bonds, and the quiet resilience needed to mend what time fractured.

name: Kerub
desc: Waking in an enchanted forest with no memory after a brutal attack, a young woman disguises herself as a nun and joins a mysterious dweller learning he is a celestial being protecting truths vital to all life.

name: DNK
desc: Eeswar’s obsession with quick money and a better life lands him in debt. When he plans a jewellery shop robbery, the heist goes hilariously wrong, bringing a storm of trouble to the very family that stands by him.

name: View
desc: Living alone in a secluded villa, Julie senses someone watching her. After her boyfriend dies in an accident, a string of mysterious deaths draws her into a web of secrets, forcing her to make a dangerous choice.

name: Itllu Arjuna
desc: A beautifully intense commercial entertainer proving that raw emotion requires no words. Arjun must stand up as a shield for his community when systemic forces threaten his family and personal pride.

name: Pratap
desc: Framed for murder by the system he served, decorated encounter specialist Pratap goes on the run, dodging his former police allies to expose a corrupt state conspiracy trailing his old record in the dark.

name: Aadarsha Kutumbam House No: 47
desc: A seemingly perfect family at House No. 47 begins to unravel when an unexpected incident exposes hidden tensions. As secrets surface and relationships strain, each member must face the truth behind their ideal image.

name: Jailer 2
desc: When a dangerous syndicate expands its reach to threaten his family's peace, retired jailer Tiger Muthuvel Pandian goes undercover as a driver. Operating from the shadows, he takes on ruthless new enemies to protect his home.

name: Muta Mestri (1993)
desc: A fearless union leader takes on a powerful politician and his criminal network after witnessing the exploitation of workers. As the battle intensifies, he must rally the people around him and stand up against a system built on fear.

name: Samurai Vengeance
desc: An act of revenge makes a young kabuki performer a local hero. Eighteen months later, a samurai arrives to question those who witnessed it, and their conflicting accounts begin to unravel the celebrated tale.

name: Hexed
desc: An awkward teenager discovers that what makes them different may actually be magical. As hidden powers emerge, they are drawn into a secret world of witches, magic and adventure that could change their life forever.

name: Lilo & Scratch
desc: After bringing home a cute pink kitten named Scratch, Lilo leaves Stitch to babysit their new pet. But Scratch is hiding a wild secret, forcing Stitch into a chaotic battle to protect Pudge and keep their home from falling apart.

name: Mannavan
desc: Entangled in a web of quirky relationship hurdles and unforeseen challenges, two passionate lovers navigate unexpected misunderstandings and emotional tests to keep their bond strong in a vibrant modern journey.

name: Gunmaaster G9
desc: A humble dairy farmer is forced into a deadly race against time when a ruthless gang threatens his loved ones, compelling him to unleash the dangerous side of himself he thought he had buried forever.

name: Laagi Chhoote Na
desc: In a small Uttar Pradesh town, student leader Raja Mishra finds himself caught between Geeta, who loves him, and Kayanat, a researcher he grows close to. A secret identity sets off a tangled romance filled with emotional conflict.

name: Haindava
desc: Set around a centuries-old Dasavatara temple, this action-spiritual drama follows a determined protagonist who rises to protect the sacred shrine from destruction, confronting powerful forces threatening its heritage, faith, and spiritual legacy.

name: King of Salangpur
desc: Long before Salangpur became a beacon of faith, one saint's devotion changed everything. This film retraces how Gopalanand Swami brought Hanuman Dada's divine idol to life for suffering people.

name: Bala 369: Atajani Kaanche
desc: Leading a quiet life as a rural electrician, young Bala is thrust into a hilarious, magical adventure where uncanny events connect his ancestral secrets with his village's destiny, sparking unexpected peril.

name: Delivery Boy
desc: A young food delivery rider, who dreams of becoming a police officer, is forced to steal money to save his critically injured mother. Months later, when he discovers that the same man has been falsely accused of murder, he risks everything to save the life he once unknowingly changed forever.

name: Mysaa
desc: Set in the culturally rich world of the Gond tribes, this emotional action thriller follows a fierce woman whose strength and resilience are tested by intense challenges, with Rashmika Mandanna in a transformative role.

name: Focker In-Law
desc: The Focker family comedy returns as Greg Focker, now older and navigating life from the other side of the dinner table, faces fresh chaos when his son Henry’s engagement sparks a new wave of awkward in-law drama and generational clashes within the Byrnes-Focker clan.

name: High
desc: Chasing different versions of a high, a group of young people get caught up in money, alcohol, risky bets and the fight for self-respect. When a sudden crime brings their paths together, every choice has a cost.

name: Sanjog
desc: When two men set their hearts on marrying the same girl, destiny takes charge. As love is tested through unexpected circumstances, emotional bonds and difficult choices, only fate can decide whose union it will be.

name: Rajanivaasa
desc: When mysterious deaths in a remote village are dismissed as a fire accident, suspicious locals begin worshipping the victims, forcing two brave officers to uncover the sinister secrets behind a sacred facade.

name: Josephine
desc: After 8-year-old Josephine witnesses a brutal assault, she begins acting out violently to protect herself. This emotional trauma leads to conflicts between her parents as they search for justice and a way to feel safe again.

name: You Can See Everything
desc: With Elizabeth Holmes weeks away from prison, Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim begin documenting her daily life. Their access to the Theranos founder becomes a probing look at truth, deception and performance.

name: Gana Dhav Re
desc: An ordinary devotee’s faith is put to the test when a crisis threatens the Ganesh festivities in Konkan’s Krupawadi. With just 15 days to make a new idol, the Sawant family and villagers must answer Bappa’s call.

name: Ananthapayana
desc: Beginning amid serene pastoral landscapes, shepherd Beera's journey takes a harrowing turn into systemic oppression, confronting rigid caste hierarchies, ruthless political power, police brutality, and deep family fractures in a gritty fight for survival.

name: Yeh Prem Mol Liya
desc: Ayushmann Khurrana and Sharvari headline Yeh Prem Mol Liya, a Sooraj Barjatya romantic family drama that brings timeless love, cherished relationships and heartfelt emotions to the big screen.

name: Miranda Warning
desc: When a mysterious crime shatters the quiet of a rural holiday home, an uncompromising cop navigates a maze of hidden motives, racing against a tight clock to catch a calculating killer before they escape.

name: Cosmic Samson
desc: A pizza delivery agent gets an extraordinary twist to his routine when mysterious powers thrust him into a hidden fantasy world, setting him on a larger-than-life journey unlike anything he has known beyond his wildest dreams.

name: Dads Little Friend
desc: From silly squabbles to shared laughter, a father and daughter find their rhythm through everyday ups and downs, celebrating the little moments that make their bond one of a kind and turn each day into a new memory.

name: Tibro
desc: Packed with relentless action, suspense, and emotional depth, this Assamese thriller follows debutant leads Zulfi Shaikh and Preety Kongana through a high-stakes web of confrontation, loyalty, and survival on the big screen.
